title: Ganoderic acid A accelerates osteoporotic fracture healing by promoting osteogenic differentiation via estrogen receptor alpha binding.
authors: Tang, Kecheng; Chen, Yiru; Yu, Yan; Huang, Zhizhen; Zhang, Hang; Tian, Yun; Li, Min; Yin, Yue; Yang, Baoxue; Liu, Bingchuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究灵芝酸A通过雌激素受体α促进成骨分化加速骨折愈合，虽涉及分子模拟表征配体-受体结合，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法用于TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Ganoderic acid A (GAA), a natural triterpenoid derived from the fungal species Ganoderma lucidum which is known for its medicinal properties, is well recognized for its anti-inflammatory, anti-aging, kidney-protective, and hepatoprotective properties. However, its role in osteoporotic fracture (OF) healing remains unclear.This study aims to explore the pharmacological effects of GAA on OF healing and to clarify its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: An ovariectomized femoral fracture model was treated with GAA or estradiol benzoate. Callus formation, mineralization and bone mineral density (BMD) were assessed by micro-computed tomography, radiographic scoring and DXA. Mechanical properties were evaluated by three-point bending tests. Histological analyses and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay for serum bone formation and resorption markers were performed. RNA sequencing with GO, KEGG and GSEA analyses was used to explore molecular mechanisms. In vitro, MC3T3-E1 cells were used to assess osteogenic differentiation under GAA, estrogen receptor (ER) antagonist (ICI 182780) or selective ERalpha antagonist (Methyl-piperidino-pyrazole dihydrochloride, MPP) treatment. Biophysical interaction assays and molecular simulations were employed to characterize GAA-ERalpha interactions. RESULTS: GAA enhanced early callus mineralization, bone volume fraction, callus volume and trabecular number, and increased radiographic union, bone mineral density and flexural rigidity in OF mice. Histological analysis showed increased soft callus and mineralized bone with elevated bone formation and resorption markers. Transcriptomic analyses indicated that GAA modulated hormone-related pathways, identifying the estrogen signaling pathway as a key target. In vitro, GAA promoted alkaline phosphatase activity, mineral deposition and expressions of phosphorylated extracellular signal-regulated kinases 1/2 (p-ERK1/2), Runt-related transcription factor 2 (RUNX2) and bone morphogenetic protein 2 (BMP2), all of which were abrogated by ICI 182780 and MPP. Notably, molecular interaction studies demonstrated direct and stable binding of GAA to ERalpha. CONCLUSION: GAA promotes osteogenic differentiation and accelerates OF healing via ERalpha. THE TRANSLATIONAL POTENTIAL OF THIS ARTICLE: The work offers a conceptual advance by identifying a fungal-derived small molecule that functions as an ERalpha ligand to promote fracture repair, supporting its potential as a therapeutic candidate for OF.
abstract_zh: 目的：灵芝酸A（GAA）是一种源自药用真菌灵芝（Ganoderma lucidum）的天然三萜类化合物，以其抗炎、抗衰老、肾脏保护和肝脏保护特性而闻名。然而，其在骨质疏松性骨折（OF）愈合中的作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨GAA对OF愈合的药理效应，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：采用去卵巢股骨骨折模型，给予GAA或苯甲酸雌二醇治疗。通过显微计算机断层扫描、放射学评分和双能X线吸收法评估骨痂形成、矿化和骨矿物质密度（BMD）。通过三点弯曲试验评估力学性能。进行组织学分析及血清骨形成和骨吸收标志物的酶联免疫吸附测定。采用RNA测序结合GO、KEGG和GSEA分析探索分子机制。体外实验中，使用MC3T3-E1细胞评估GAA、雌激素受体（ER）拮抗剂（ICI 182780）或选择性ERα拮抗剂（甲基哌啶吡唑二盐酸盐，MPP）处理下的成骨分化。采用生物物理相互作用测定和分子模拟表征GAA-ERα相互作用。结果：GAA增强了OF小鼠的早期骨痂矿化、骨体积分数、骨痂体积和骨小梁数量，并提高了放射学愈合评分、骨矿物质密度和抗弯刚度。组织学分析显示，软骨痂和矿化骨增加，伴随骨形成和骨吸收标志物升高。转录组分析表明，GAA调节激素相关通路，确定雌激素信号通路为关键靶点。体外实验中，GAA促进了碱性磷酸酶活性、矿物质沉积以及磷酸化细胞外信号调节激酶1/2（p-ERK1/2）、Runt相关转录因子2（RUNX2）和骨形态发生蛋白2（BMP2）的表达，所有这些效应均被ICI 182780和MPP所消除。值得注意的是，分子相互作用研究证明GAA与ERα直接且稳定结合。结论：GAA通过ERα促进成骨分化并加速OF愈合。本文的转化潜力：本研究通过识别一种作为ERα配体促进骨折修复的真菌来源小分子，提供了概念性进展，支持其作为OF治疗候选药物的潜力。
